what: The planned parse-rate-check replacement uses invalid and incomplete argv
scenario_or_breakage: The plan says pass --id-grammar "FINDING", but parse-rate-check only accepts finding-only or finding-oos. The legacy no---voter-tools branch also has no voter_tool value. Following the plan can make review tally abort under set -e or break MAV/legacy re-tally paths.
suggested_fix: Use --id-grammar finding-oos for code-review ballots. In the three-slot branch pass VOTER_TOOLS[$slot]. In the legacy branch either keep the current sidecar check or pass a stable fallback voter-tool label with blank slot.

what: Planned Check 15 asserts FINDING_N and OOS_N in validation-phase.md, but the plan does not add those literals
scenario_or_breakage: validation-phase.md currently has the negotiation section but no FINDING_N or OOS_N text. Adding only the proposed harness assertions makes bash scripts/test-research-structure.sh fail after this PR.
suggested_fix: Add the minimal validation-phase.md contract text that the new assertions pin, or retarget Check 15 to an existing authoritative file that already contains the ballot protocol.
